import django
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(DEBUG=True, USE_TZ=True, INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes','django.contrib.auth'], DATABASES={})
django.setup()
from django import forms
from django.contrib.postgres.forms import SplitArrayField
from django.forms.widgets import CheckboxInput

field = SplitArrayField(forms.BooleanField(required=False), size=4)
widget = field.widget

def states(value, attrs=None):
    ctx = widget.get_context('arr', value, attrs)
    return [s['attrs'].get('checked', False) for s in ctx['widget']['subwidgets']]

assert states([True, False, False, True]) == [True, False, False, True], states([True, False, False, True])
assert states([False, True, False, False]) == [False, True, False, False]
assert states([False]*4) == [False]*4
assert states([True]*4) == [True]*4
assert states(None) == [False]*4
assert states([]) == [False]*4
assert states([True, False]) == [True, False, False, False]
print('all boolean-array cases OK')

# caller-supplied attrs must not be mutated (root cause in CheckboxInput)
attrs = {'class': 'x', 'id': 'id_arr'}
widget.get_context('arr', [True, False, False, True], attrs)
assert attrs == {'class': 'x', 'id': 'id_arr'}, attrs
assert 'checked' not in attrs
print('caller attrs unmutated OK')

# CheckboxInput standalone behaviour
ci = CheckboxInput()
a = {'class': 'y'}
assert ci.get_context('a', True, a)['widget']['attrs']['checked'] is True
assert a == {'class': 'y'}, a
assert ci.get_context('a', True, None)['widget']['attrs']['checked'] is True
assert 'checked' not in ci.get_context('a', False, {'class': 'y'})['widget']['attrs']
assert 'checked' not in ci.get_context('a', None, None)['widget']['attrs']
print('CheckboxInput attrs OK')

# non-boolean split arrays still render per-index values/ids
class F(forms.Form):

ctx = F(initial={'txt': ['a', 'b']})['txt'].widget.get_context('txt', ['a', 'b'], {'id': 'id_txt'})
subs = ctx['widget']['subwidgets']
assert [s['attrs']['id'] for s in subs] == ['id_txt_0', 'id_txt_1', 'id_txt_2']
assert [s['value'] for s in subs] == ['a', 'b', None], [s['value'] for s in subs]
print('text array ids/values OK')
